quote: Except as provided in subsection 3, a person shall not drive a motorcycle, moped or trimobile abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane. Motorcycles and mopeds may, with the consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.

activation.condition: Person drives a motorcycle, moped or trimobile with another vehicle within the same traffic lane.

obligation.description: Do not drive abreast of, overtake or pass the other vehicle within that lane.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as provided in subsection 3; motorcycles and mopeds may, with consent of the drivers, be operated no more than two abreast in a single traffic lane.
exceptions.condition: Two motorcycle or moped drivers consent and no more than two ride abreast.
exceptions.effect: Permitted abreast operation; not applicable to a motorcycle-car pair.

timing.description: Compare original complete body overlap and behind-to-ahead episode at 20 Hz over 30 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: abreast of or overtake or pass another vehicle within the same traffic lane
judgment_calls_needed.note: Require original full-body lane and longitudinal order; consent and subsection 3 cannot be inferred from adjacency.
